takeaway: Cloudflare's security-audit skill more than doubled its pace, gaining 2,654 stars in a day with no announcement found. morluto/rea (+9,258) still leads on volume, and the two repos that vanished this week now leave the ranking.

findings.heading: Fastest measured growth, Oct 21 to Oct 22
findings.text: Between two of the radar's own readings: morluto/rea +9,258 stars, cloudflare/security-audit-skill +2,654, DietrichGebert/ponytail +1,873, stablyai/orca +1,610, debpalash/VoiceStudio +1,458. 43 repos were compared day on day.

findings.heading: Cloudflare's security skill is accelerating with no trigger found
findings.text: It went from about +1,147 stars a day to +2,654 in the last day. Its last commit was Sep 14 and no new post or listing was found. It has 14 commits and 139 watchers.

findings.heading: Two vanished repos now leave the ranking
findings.text: YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge (404 since Oct 21) and corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect (404 on Oct 22, the shutdown date its README announced) are no longer scored. Their observations are kept.

findings.heading: A new AI sales agent tells users to skip permission prompts
findings.text: ethanplusai/harvey gained 1,491 of its 2,020 stars this week. It looks like a genuine launch, but it is an agent that sends email for you, and a scan flags its instruction to run Claude Code with permissions skipped.

findings.heading: Vertical enterprise AI keeps compounding
findings.text: Legora raised $550M at an $8.8B valuation with ARR above $200M, up from $100M in April. Pigment raised $250M with ARR above $100M, doubling year on year. Both were read from search results.

findings.heading: Context compression is fast but crowded
findings.text: OpenAI and Anthropic ship compaction in their APIs, gateways pass it through, and YC startups sell it. The open gap is a neutral layer that works across providers, with independent quality evidence.

caveats: Every company figure today came from search-result summaries; no news site could be opened from the cloud environment.
Hugging Face and Hacker News were not retried: both have been unreachable for three days.
ai-job-search moved to a new owner (ai-job-search-dev); the radar still tracks it under its old address.
Some apps still rank on gains stated up to a week ago, ahead of growth the radar measured itself.
No forecast has matured yet; the first scorecard is expected around 2026-10-27.
